interest: Covers Japan's recruitment of T. H. Greene to spy on the US, and consular reporting on Chinese-Japanese propaganda in Victoria.
overview: Covers 1932-34 naval reports on Japan's recruitment of British subject T. H. Greene to spy on the US and Philippines, plus a Far Eastern Affairs memo on competing Japanese and Chinese propaganda in Victoria, British Columbia after the 1932 Shanghai crisis.
